text:
Emma: Quick sync — proposing a small "quick-win" onboarding cohort for webinar signups. Idea: first 150 early adopters get 50 starter credits + a curated prompt pack + a 3-day activation nudge sequence. Goal: lift 7-day activation and reduce time-to-first-success. Thoughts?

Matt: Love the idea. Do we have baseline numbers to benchmark uplift and justify the credit spend? :eyes:

Emma: Baseline from last webinar: ~18% used the API within 7 days, 7-day retention ~9%. If we can push usage to ~30% that would be a clear signal. Back-of-envelope cost: 150 * 50 credits — I’ll convert to $ after lunch.

Sara: Can we run this as an A/B test? Variant A = credits only, Variant B = credits + prompt pack + 1-click import. Channel mix: email + in-app banner + DM in community Slack.

Liam: Prompt pack is mostly done — 8 starter prompts across search, summarization, and chat signatures. We can wire a 1-click import to Console so users see an instant example. Need product help for the import endpoint URL.

Nina: I can own the routing: tag webinar_signups -> hubspot workflow "spark_quickwin_cohort". Questions: cap at first 150 globally or per-region? And we need copy for subject lines and in-app banners.

Emma: Draft subject line options: 
- "Welcome — your 50 starter credits are waiting"
- "3 quick prompts to get results in 5 minutes"
- "Jumpstart with 50 credits + ready-to-run prompts"

Emma: Proposed nudge cadence (quick snippet):
```
Day0: Email -> credits + prompt pack + CTA (1-click import)
Day1: In-app banner -> run one prompt (quick win)
Day3: Email -> short case study + pro-tip + reminder
Day7: Slack DM -> join cohort office hours (optional)
```

Matt: Recommend global cap of 150 but soft-roll by region if we see overload. Also add per-account cap (one redemption per org). That prevents gaming.

Nina: noted — I'll build the workflow with a property check: if contact.org_credit_redeemed == true then skip. Also will add HubSpot property `cohort_spark` and limit enrollment to first 150 contacts with tag + property empty.

Sara: I'll set up the A/B test events in Amplitude: webinar_cohort_experiment, starter_credit_redeemed, prompt_pack_imported, first_api_call_within_7d. Will create dashboards for conversion and 7-day retention.

Liam: Product ask — can engineering expose a short endpoint for the 1-click import: POST /api/v1/console/import-templates with a tokenized redirect? If not, we can deep-link to docs but import is higher impact.

Emma: @Liam can you own the product/engineering ask? Matt and I will draft a one-pager (hypothesis, metrics, cost). Nina + Sara, please start copy + routing today.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Spark quick-win cohort sync" — 30m, Tue 10:00am PT. Invite sent to Emma, Matt, Sara, Liam, Nina.

Emma: Perfect — thanks everyone. Small ask: keep copy tight and focus on immediate value (run one prompt in <5min). We’ll reconvene after initial cohort enrollment (target: 150 or 7 days). :rocket:
